maddeler.e: فَيْلَزَهْرَج or فِيلَزَهْرَج • (faylazahraj or fīlazahraj) m
maddeler.t: Borrowed from Middle Persian *pīl-i zahrag (literally “elephant’s bile”) from pyl (/⁠pīl⁠/, “elephant”) + zʾhl (/⁠zahr⁠/, “poison”).
s: Borrowed from Middle Persian *pīl-i zahrag (literally “elephant’s bile”)
g: boxthorn (Lycium edgeworthii syn. Lycium indicum) or its sap
